events.name: Abyssal Baths
events.summary: You find a secluded area with a strange pool of liquid. You can either immerse yourself in it, increasing your Max HP at the cost of taking damage as many times as you wish, or gather the salts around the pool to recover some HP.
choices: Immerse: Gain 2 Max HP. Take 3 damage.
Abstain: Heal 10 HP.

events.name: Amalgamator
events.summary: You discover and enter a workshop where a strange figure was waiting for you. You may combine two of your Strikes or Defends into an Ultimate Strike or Defend respectively.
choices: Combine Strikes: Remove 2 Strikes. Add Ultimate Strike to your Deck.
Combine Defends: Remove 2 Defends. Add Ultimate Defend to your Deck.

events.name: Aroma of Chaos
events.summary: You begin hallucinating upon smelling a strange mix of scents in the air. You may either let the illusions cloud your mind to transform a card in your deck, or resist them to upgrade a card in your deck.
choices: Let Go: Transform a card in your Deck.
Maintain Control: Upgrade a card in your Deck.

events.name: Battleworn Dummy
events.summary: You approach a training dummy when it suddenly activates, offering a selection of battle options for you to test your might on. You have 3 turns to defeat the dummy, and if you fail to defeat them in that time, you get nothing. If you win, you gain a reward depending on the option you chose.
choices: Setting 1: Fight a 75 HP dummy. Procure 1 random Potion.
Setting 2: Fight a 150 HP dummy. Upgrade 2 random cards.
Setting 3: Fight a 300 HP dummy. Obtain a random Relic.

events.name: Brain Leech
events.area: Act 1 - Overgrowth, Act 1 - Underdocks, Act 2 - Hive
events.summary: You contract a Brain Leech seeking knowledge. You may choose to share knowledge with it to add 1 of 5 cards to your deck, or rip it out to earn a colorless card reward at the cost of some HP.
choices: Share Knowledge: Choose 1 of 5 random cards to add to your deck.
Rip the Leech Off: Lose 5 HP. Gain a Colorless card reward.

events.name: Bugslayer
events.summary: You fight a group of insects when a warrior offers his assistance. After the fight, he offers to teach you one of his techniques, allowing you to add one of two special cards to your deck.
choices: Learn Extermination Technique: Add Exterminate to your Deck.
Learn Squash Technique: Add Squash to your Deck.

events.name: Byrdonis Nest
events.summary: A large byrd flees from an enormous beast, leaving its nest and egg unattended for you to sneak in and steal from. You may either consume the egg to increase your Max HP, or stash it away to add it into your deck.
choices: Eat the Egg: Gain 7 Max HP.
Take the Egg: Add Byrdonis Egg to deck.

events.name: Colorful Philosophers
events.summary: You stumble upon a group of colored statues arguing over which color is the best. You may join in and obtain three card rewards of varying rarities from a different character of your choice.

events.summary: You come across an enormous flower with sharp, venomous petals growing on a mountain of bones. You can grab the nectar dripping off of it to obtain some gold, or climb deeper into it to obtain more at the cost of some HP, or obtain the unique Pollinous Core relic.
choices: Extract Nectar: Gain 35 Gold.
Reach Deeper: Lose 5 HP. Advance to the next level.

Insert Event Potion: Lose a specified Event potion. Obtain an Upgraded Rare [Attack/Skill/Power] card reward.
Insert Token Potion: Lose a specified Token potion. Obtain an Upgraded Common [Attack/Skill] card reward. === Mechanics ===

events.name: The Lantern Key
events.summary: You stumble upon a strange key when a heavily armored knight asks you to give it to them. You may oblige and obtain some gold, or take the key by force by facing the knight head-on.
choices: Return the Key: Gain 100 Gold.
Keep the Key: Enter combat against a Mysterious Knight for the Lantern Key card.

events.name: The Legends Were True
events.summary: You enter a suspicious chamber with a light shining on a treasure map sitting on a pedestal. You may take the map, adding it to your deck to obtain its treasure later, or look around the room, resulting in the chamber collapsing, obtaining a potion at the cost of some HP in the process.
choices: Nab the Map: Receive the Spoils Map.
Slowly Find an Exit: Lose 8 HP. Procure 1 random Potion.

events.name: The Lost Wisp
choices: Capture the Wisp: Add Decay (curse) to Deck. Obtain the Lost Wisp (relic).
Search the Nearby Area: Gain 45-75 Gold.

events.name: The Merchant???
events.summary: You meet a strange man selling a variety of cheap imitations of various Relics. If you have a Foul Potion, you can throw it at them to start a fight with them for great rewards.

events.name: The Round Tea Party
events.summary: You show up to a tea party in the stead of a knight with a party of powerful figures. You can either drink the tea, fully healing you, but giving you a negative relic for the rest of the run, or start a fight to obtain a relic at the cost of some HP.
choices: Enjoy Your Tea: Obtain Royal Poison (relic). Heal to full HP.
Pick a Fight: Lose 11 HP. Obtain a random Relic.

events.name: The Sunken Statue
events.summary: You find a crumbling stone statue submerged in the waters of the Underdocks, clutching a sword of stone. You can either take the sword as a unique relic, or claim the offerings of gold at the foot of the statue at the cost of some HP.
choices: Grab the Sword: Obtain Sword of Stone (relic).
Dive into the Water: Gain 101-121 Gold. Lose 7 HP.

events.name: The Trial
events.summary: You join a line of people and are forced into becoming the judge for a trial that you may not refuse. You may either declare the defendant guilty or innocent to obtain various rewards, though most often also resulting in you becoming Cursed.
choices: Accept: Serve as today's Decider. ===== Merchant Trial =====
DECIDE: Guilty: Add Regret (curse) to your Deck. Obtain 2 random Relics.
DECIDE: Innocent: Add Shame (curse) to your Deck. Upgrade 2 cards. ==== Noble Trial ====
DECIDE: Guilty: Heal 10 HP.
DECIDE: Innocent: Add Regret (curse) to your Deck. Gain 300 Gold. ==== Nondescript Trial ====
DECIDE: Guilty: Add Doubt (curse) to your Deck. Gain 2 card rewards.
DECIDE: Innocent: Add Doubt (curse) to your Deck. Transform 2 cards. === Reject ===
Reject: You are not allowed to Reject.
Double Down: Face lethal repercussions.

events.name: This or That?
events.summary: Two arms suddenly burst out from a hole in the wall, carrying a bag of gold in one hand and a relic in another. You can take the gold at the cost of some HP, or the relic at the cost of becoming cursed.
choices: This: Lose 6 HP. Gain 41-68 Gold.
That: Add Clumsy to your Deck. Obtain a random Relic.

events.name: Tinker Time
events.summary: You meet a scientist who offers to create you a powerful card of your chosing. You can 2 of 3 categories of cards, and then 2 of 3 unique effects added onto the card.

events.name: Trash Heap
events.summary: You find an enormous tower of discarded matter. You can rummage through the waste to obtain one of several unique Relics at the cost of some HP, or scavenge around the garbage to obtain some gold and add a unique card to your deck.
choices: Dive In: Lose 8 HP. Obtain a random Relic.
Grab Random Junk: Gain 100 Gold. Obtain a random card.

events.name: Unrest Site
events.summary: You start a fire to take a rest when the fire grows and flickers towards a forest of oil-soaked trees. You may either sleep anyways to fully heal yourself at the cost of adding a curse to your deck, or destroy the trees to obtain a relic at the cost of some Max HP.
choices: Rest Anyways: Heal to full HP. Receive Poor Sleep (curse).
Kill the Trees: Lose 8 Max HP. Obtain a random Relic.

events.name: War Historian, Repy
events.summary: You find someone trapped in a cage next to a chest filled with loot. You may either unlock the chest to obtain its loot or free the scholar for the powerful History Course Relic.
choices: Unlock the Cage: Lose Lantern Key. Obtain History Course.
Unlock the Chest: Lose Lantern Key. Procure 2 random Potions. Obtain 2 random Relics.

events.name: Waterlogged Scriptorium
events.summary: You discover a small, run-down shop filled with various scrolls and trinkets. You can pay gold to enchant 1 or 2 cards with an enchantment that allows you to retain the card, or you may not buy anything and get a boost to Max HP instead.
choices: Bloody Ink: Gain 6 Max HP.
Tentacle Quill: Pay 55 Gold. Enchant a card with Steady.
Prickly Sponge: Pay 99 Gold. Enchant 2 cards with Steady.

events.name: Welcome to Wongo's
events.summary: You meet an extremely unenthusiastic clerk in a shop selling a variety of Relics. You can purchase a random common relic, a specific rare relic, or a ticket that gives you multiple random relics after enough combat encounters. You may also refuse to purchase anything, downgrading a card in the process.
choices: Wongo's Bargain Bin: Pay 100 Gold. Obtain 1 random Common Relic.
Wongo's Featured Item: Pay 200 Gold. Obtain [Rare Relic].
Wongo's Mystery Box: Pay 300 Gold. Obtain 3 random Relics after 5 combats.

Leave: Downgrade a random card. === Wongo Points === After any purchase, the player will receive Wongo Points based on which purchase they selected. Wongo Points persist between all of the player's runs on their profile (across all characters), and the event text ...

events.name: Wellspring
events.summary: You follow a low rumble to its source to encounter a spring with emerald-colored water. You can bottle up the water to gain a random potion, or bathe in it to remove a card from your deck at the cost of adding a temporary curse to your deck.
choices: Bottle: Procure 1 random Potion.
Bathe: Remove 1 card from Deck. Add 1 Guilty (curse) to Deck.

events.name: Whispering Hollow
events.summary: You discover a creepy, whispering tree with clay vessels hanging from its branches. You may give some gold to the tree to obtain two potions, or hug the tree to transform a card in your deck at the cost of some HP.
choices: Exchange Gold: Lose 26-44 Gold. Procure 2 random Potions.
Hug the Tree: Lose 9 HP. Choose a card to Transform.

events.name: Wood Carvings
events.summary: You open a with three wooden carvings next to a pedestal indented with the shape of the carvings. You can transform a starter card into a unique attack or skill card, or enchant a card with an enchantment that randomizes its cost.
choices: Bird: Choose 1 starter card to Transform into Peck.
Snake: Enchant 1 card with Slither. (Locked if no cards can be enchanted with Slither)
Torus: Choose 1 starter card to Transform into Toric Toughness.

events.name: Zen Weaver
choices: Breathing Techniques: Pay 50 Gold. Add 2 Enlightenment to your Deck.
Emotional Awareness: Pay 125 Gold. Remove 1 card from your Deck.
Arachnid Acupuncture: Pay 250 Gold. Remove 2 cards from your Deck.

run.acts: 3 acts. Act 1 is randomly Overgrowth or Underdocks; Act 2 Hive; Act 3 Glory. Every act starts with an Ancient (Act 1 always Neow) and ends with a boss: floors 17 / 33 / 48 (A10: second boss on 49). Victory = beating the Act 3 boss (no Act 4 / keys).
run.start: 99 Gold, 3 potion slots (A4: 2), starter relic, 10-12 card deck (5 characters), 3 Energy, draw 5.
run.act_transition: Act 1/2 boss -> 100 Gold (A3: 75) + 3 Rare card choice + maybe potion. No boss relic chest: the next act opens with an Ancient that heals 100% of missing HP (A2: 80%) and offers 3 Ancient relics (must take one; cannot skip).

map.source: Map Locations, Monsters, Elites, Unknown Location, Rest Sites (update history)
map.layout: Same 7 room types as StS1 (Monster, Elite, Rest, Unknown, Treasure, Merchant, Boss); the wiki's Map Generation page is empty. Treasure at the act midpoint; a Rest Site always precedes the boss; Act 1/2 have about 6-7 rest sites (patch notes).
map.monster_pools: First 3 fights in Act 1 (2 in Acts 2-3) from the easy pool (StS2 Act 1 lists 3-4 easy encounters, 3 picked per run), then the normal pool with equal probability. The same encounter never repeats within an act.
map.elite_rules: All 3 elites of the act must be met before any repeats; never the same elite twice in a row.
map.unknown_room: Base Monster 10%, Treasure 2%, Shop 3%, Event 85%; non-rolled types grow by their base value, reset when rolled and at each new act. No Shop right after a Shop. Each event can occur once per run.

rewards.source: Cards, Gold, Potions, Relics, Elites, Map Locations
rewards.card_reward: Choose 1 of 3. Base C/U/R normal 60/37/3%, elite 50/40/10%, shop 54/37/9%. Rare offset starts -5%, +1% per non-Rare card generated (A7: +0.5%, base Rare halved), max +40%, reset on Rare; skipped rewards still count. Boss rewards are all Rare. Upgraded non-rare reward cards: Act 1 0%, Act 2 25%, Act 3 50% (A7: halved).
rewards.potion_drop: 40% at run start, -10% after a drop / +10% after none; elites +12.5%. Rarity 65/25/10%.
rewards.elite: Relic (C/U/R 50/33/17%) + 35-45 Gold + card reward + maybe potion.
rewards.chests: One relic (50/33/17%) + 42-53 Gold. Character-specific relics never appear in chests (multiplayer fairness). Skipped chest relics return to the pool.
rewards.ancients: Replace StS1 boss relics: 8 Ancients (Neow Act 1; Orobas/Pael/Tezcatara Act 2; Nonupeipe/Tanx/Vakuu Act 3; Darv Act 2 or 3) each with relic pools; Neow offers 1 relic from a Curse pool (upside with downside) + 2 from a Positive pool.

shop.stock: Same layout as StS1: 5 class cards (2A/2S/1P, one 50% off), 2 colorless (U + R, +15%), 3 relics (rightmost a Shop relic), 3 potions, 1 card removal.
shop.fake_merchant: The Merchant??? event sells cheap fake relics; can be fought with a Foul Potion.

rest_site.options: Rest (heal 30%) or Smith (upgrade). Relic/quest options: Train (Girya), Dig (Shovel), Cook (Meat Cleaver: remove 2 cards, +5 Max HP), Kindle (Pumpkin Candle), Clone (Clone enchantment), Hatch (Byrdonis Egg quest). Multiplayer adds Mend (heal an ally 30%). Miniature Tent allows every option at one site.

new_systems.enchantments: Permanent card modifiers (one per card) from relics/events/Ancients.
new_systems.afflictions: Negative per-combat modifiers enemies put on your cards.
new_systems.quest_cards: Unplayable deck cards with delayed rewards (Byrdonis Egg, Dowsing, Lantern Key, Spoils Map).
new_systems.eternal: Curses that cannot be removed or transformed.
new_systems.alternate_acts: Act 1 is one of two themed acts (more planned).

multiplayer.rule: Co-op for up to 4 players. Map: vote, ties resolved randomly weighted by votes; every act is 1 floor shorter (bosses on 16/31/45). Combat: shared enemies, simultaneous turns (turn ends when all players end); enemies attack/debuff ALL players at once, each player blocks individually; enemy debuffs (Weak/Vulnerable) apply for everyone. Dead players revive at 1 HP next floor if someone survived. Potions can be thrown to allies. Separate card rewards and shops; chests offer one relic per player (rock-paper-scissors on conflicts); Ancients offer each player their own picks. 37 multiplayer-only cards.
multiplayer.enemy_scaling: Enemy HP = base x players x act factor (Act 1 1.1, Act 2/3 1.2, Act 3 boss 1.3), e.g. 4 players in Act 2 = x4.8. Enemy Block and most stacking buffs scale the same way; Plating x(2p-1); Artifact +(p-1); Slippery xp. Enemy damage, debuffs and status cards do NOT scale (but hit everyone).

elites_bosses.rule: 3 elites and 3 bosses per act variant. A10: two different Act 3 bosses back to back. Act 3 boss gives no rewards.

ascension.effect: Ancients only heal 80% of your missing HP.
Enemies and Treasure Chests drop 25% less Gold.
Start each run with 1 less potion slot.
Removing cards from your deck at the Merchant is more expensive.
Rare and Upgraded cards appear less often.
All enemies are harder to kill.
(Max Level) Fight two Bosses at the end of Act 3.
